reportedProblems: Unsupported textsc algorithm names exposed raw LaTeX.
Selecting/copying KaTeX included both semantic MathML and the visual HTML, duplicating alpha, hats and bounds.

fix.textscPresentation: Bounded trusted macro alias to upright algorithm names; original TeX stays unchanged.
fix.selection: Semantic MathML is non-selectable but remains available to assistive technology.
fix.clipboard: Selected source formulas copied once as their original delimited TeX; partial formula selection expands to its complete original formula.
fix.punctuation: Punctuation stays beside its formula rather than wrapping to the next line.

verification.nativeClipboard: Actual DOM selection and native ClipboardEvent through reader React handlers; no provider response mocks needed.

limits: The source is a dedicated readonly card of the user-reported excerpts, not a complete imported paper.
Unknown math syntax still falls back to original text.
Copying a formula uses TeX intentionally to retain notation rather than flattening hats or superscripts.
